Rejecting it because Internal Quality Checks row 10 says no-network would be wrong. A separate broken environment with cpus=0 would defeat a mere key-presence check. The read-only in-memory profile probes rejected both broken configurations and the redundant allow_internet=true variant; the frozen configuration passed.
